unitFile.title: unitFile
unitFile.description: Name of the .voud file (in the units/ folder) to load into the verona-player

variablesFile.title: variablesFile
variablesFile.description: Name of the companion .xml file (in the units/ folder) declaring the unit's response variables

nextTaskEvent.title: nextTaskEvent
nextTaskEvent.description: State machine event name triggered when the player requests navigation past the end of the unit; wire this event's transition to the next_task() DSL operator

previousTaskEvent.title: previousTaskEvent
previousTaskEvent.description: State machine event name triggered when the player requests navigation before the start of the unit; wire this event's transition to the back_task() DSL operator
